description: The WATNEEDS code item is a separate Figshare deposit within the global crop-water collection. Its own page lists a text source file used to calculate yearly and monthly crop-specific green and blue water requirements. The describing article connects the calculations to crop evapotranspiration, precipitation, irrigation and soil-water balances. A modeller can inspect the procedure when adapting the published gridded inputs to another crop calendar or climate scenario. The small source file is not a ready hosted service, and the paper's assumptions about planting dates and water-use efficiency still need local checking. The item states CC0, while the parent collection DOI registers CC BY 4.0; the file's own rights control this draft. I read the item and article metadata without opening the code file or running calculations. The related NetCDF data collection is reviewed separately. No existing catalogue record was found. A limitation is that code alone does not validate new crop calendars or local irrigation practices.
